deploymentNotes: Publish via: fga model write --store-id $OPENFGA_STORE_ID --file model.v2.fga
Capture returned authorization_model_id; set as OPENFGA_MODEL_ID_CANDIDATE.
Leave OPENFGA_MODEL_ID pointing at the v1 model until DAUTH_OPENFGA_SHADOW=true soak shows <0.1% mismatch.
Then flip OPENFGA_MODEL_ID to the v2 id; keep v1 in the store for audit replay.
